# Kenney assets (CC0)

Downloaded 2026-11-11 from kenney.nl. Both packs are Creative Commons Zero (see each `License.txt`).
Credit: Kenney (www.kenney.nl).

- `emotes/` — Emotes Pack: `emotes_vector.svg` (every emote, all balloon styles, one sheet) and `png-style-1/` (32x38 PNGs, square balloon). Used for pad reactions.
- `mobile-controls/` — Mobile Controls 1.0: `icons/` (white glyph SVGs, 48x48), `style-b/`, `style-c/`, `style-f/` (light button, d-pad and joystick art). Used for pad icons and controls.

Copy what a package needs into that package (pad/, platform/); don't reference this folder at runtime.
